label: dueExactlyAtDelay: a write is due only after the delay, not at it
saveDuringWriteDiscards: resets not compared, so a write a save overtook is kept
failedWriteWaitsForEdit: writtenEdit cleared on failure, so a failing write retries every tick
replace: guard wrote else { writtenEdit = nil; return .retryOnNextEdit }

label: quitIgnoresDirty: a clean window's quit writes a copy
quitRewritesCurrentCopy: a quit writes again when the newest edit is already on disk
